cohort: 50 healthy antenatal women without pre-existing or gestational diabetes, aged 18-35 years, and at or beyond 24 weeks of gestation.
finding: There was no significant association between maternal HbA1c levels in non-diabetic mothers and adverse pregnancy outcomes.
mod_finding: 72% had normal vaginal delivery, 2% had forceps-assisted vaginal delivery, and 26% had a cesarean section.
birth_weight: 90% of infants had normal birth weight
